title: Rat-catcher
text: Something below the quay has been at the Brine Cask's stores. Kill the rat in the cellar and Oona will give you the key she took off a drowned bargeman: it fits the bricked arch north of the cellar.

reward.item: cellar-key (item 5001, placed.quest = rat-catcher in warrens/area.json; law.item-reward)
reward.how: REFEREED: after state = 2 the referee writes ONE joint command [quest: rewarded 0->1, key: owner REF->S]; law.quest clause 7 and law.item-reward clause 8 each refuse it if the other half is missing or the quest is not done. The xp/gold mint is a separate K-WELL turn until K-BOOK-SLOTS (law.quest-lawful).

steps.write: state 0->1, started := the rat's deaths now

steps.honestLabel: the law checks that the rat died after acceptance, not that S killed it; who struck the last blow is the referee's (accountable) judgement

steps.write: rewarded 0->1 and the key's owner := S, one command
